# Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Guide {.unnumbered}

This Open Educational Resource introduces deep learning from its conceptual and mathematical foundations through neural architectures, computer vision, sequence and language models, multimodal and generative systems, reinforcement learning, production engineering, governance, and professional responsibility.

## Audience

The book is intended for students, instructors, technical professionals, and independent learners seeking a structured introduction to deep learning.

## Prerequisites

Basic programming literacy is expected. Familiarity with algebra, introductory probability and statistics, and core machine-learning ideas will be helpful.

## Major Topics

- Deep learning and neural-network foundations
- Training, optimization, generalization, and evaluation
- Computer vision architectures and tasks
- Sequence models, Transformers, and pre-trained language models
- Multimodal, generative, and reinforcement-learning systems
- Deployment, governance, ethics, and responsible practice
